candidates.reason: This module directly imports and exercises scrapy.utils.response.open_in_browser. test_open_in_browser and test_open_in_browser_raises_for_unsupported_response_type currently assert that a plain Response raises TypeError, which contradicts the requested non-text support; the text-extension and HTML base-injection tests cover the extension-selection and existing behavior that the change must preserve.

TestViewCommand covers the scrapy view command, whose Command._print_response currently rejects responses that are not TextResponse before calling open_in_browser. test_non_text_response asserts the old Cannot view a non-text response. error and must be updated to verify the Content-Type-based path, while test_view preserves the existing success-path contract.
